about: A vast flying reptile, the largest ever to fly.
notes: v2 brief: a creature still to come; its sounds are found by id the day its definition exists.

prompts.text: A vast flying reptile, the largest ever to fly gives a deep resonant croaking call, three separate calls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A vast flying reptile, the largest ever to fly lets out a loud honking screech, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A vast flying reptile, the largest ever to fly croaks in pain, four separate cries with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A vast flying reptile, the largest ever to fly gives a long fading dying cry, two separate times with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A vast flying reptile, the largest ever to fly: snaps a huge beak shut with a clack, four separate attacks with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Enormous leathery wings beating slowly, very deep whooshes, well spaced and distinct. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
